The guy in the back takes it, looks at it with his loupe, whistles, and looks at me (now with my eyebrows way up in surprise). "Sir, I don't know what the problem was that brought on the breakup, but we're not allowed to pay more than $50 for something brought in like this. How much did you pay for it? $1500?" Now this was in '83 or thereabouts, and $1500 then is equal to $3600 now, and I was thinking I'd get a better car. But anyway he says to take it to So-and-so's Auction Barn to get some decent money for it. So I take it back to the bar, and the boss tells me "Don't bother with that. So Thursday comes along, and the boss is seated at a table with an older woman and a younger girl. I show her this ring, she says "It's her ring!" while pointing to the younger girl. I said I didn't believe it, and this old woman told me they'd been sitting at such-and-such a point in the bar, and said "That's where you found it, wasn't it?".
